subject.title: 🚨 URGENT: iOS app update breaks Talk Mode and chat — gateway connects but no functionality

question: Should the iOS owner prepare an expedited 2026.7.1 hotfix while diagnosis proceeds, or hold the current App Store build if the regression reproduces on an owner device?
rationale: The timing and corroboration indicate a newly shipped release blocker, but choosing hotfix-in-place versus halting distribution requires App Store release authority and owner-device verification.

options.title: Reproduce and hotfix
options.body: Reproduce the shipped build, repair the first failing connection transition, and submit an expedited iOS maintenance release.

options.title: Hold distribution
options.body: Pause the current build if owner-device testing confirms broad connection failure before a safe patch is ready.

recommendation.title: Reproduce and hotfix
recommendation.body: Reproduce the shipped build, repair the first failing connection transition, and submit an expedited iOS maintenance release.

likelyOwner.reason: This owner is explicitly assigned to the iOS app and is connected to recent mobile release and operator-token work.
